tinker/base/main.ts.defineMain: Type only: it gives a command's main its input type and runs nothing.

tinker/base/main-host.ts.createMainHost: The host for commands with no port: it runs before any scope exists.
tinker/base/main-host.ts.runMain: The process form of that host: it owns OS signals and the exit code.

tinker/base/panics.server.ts.observeServerPanics: The process panic hook: it must report even when the root's own close fails.

tinker/base/telemetry-worker.ts.telemetryWorkerInput: The worker thread's inputs: read from workerData before its root exists.
tinker/base/telemetry-worker.ts.serveTelemetryWorker: The worker's native loop beside its root. A span here would feed the telemetry it drains.

tinker/components/telemetry/thread.serve.plain: A check inside the native observer callbacks: a span here would feed the telemetry it sends.
